name: Zanjinden Shiki no Mura
source:
A martial artist on a journey comes upon a village attacked by ghosts. He vows to protect the village and its inhabitants to the best of his ability.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位武术家在旅途中遇到了一个被鬼袭击的村庄。他发誓要尽其所能保护村庄及其居民。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
